free_tier.stated: Starter at USD 5/month: 1 vCore Intel, 1 GB ECC memory, 10 GB SSD boot plus 2 TB of ZFS RAIDZ2 HDD storage, 10 TB transfer with unmetered inbound, 1 Gbit port with paid upgrades to 2.5 / 5 / 10 Gbit at USD 5 / 10 / 15 per month, KVM with root access, 1 IPv4 plus a /64 IPv6, Phoenix AZ. The page states 'Transfer is included in every plan' and the FAQ states 'No egress fees'.

egress.terms: flat transfer allowance included in the plan price billed monthly, inbound unmetered, no egress fee and no overage price published on the page read
egress.free_allowance: 10 TB/month on Starter (15 TB on Standard, 25 TB on Pro)

interface_detail: inferred from the tooling the provider documents; not probed
tooling: not stated on the page read: KVM with root access and full provisioning at checkout; the page names no API, S3 endpoint or client, so the 2 TB is block storage inside the VM rather than object storage
chaining: 2 TB of ZFS HDD for USD 5/month with 10 TB of transfer is the cheapest cold tier in this slice: it can hold a large share of the 20 TiB archive in one VM, but the 1 GB of RAM means a rebuild or scrub of that pool is slow and the 10 TB allowance caps a hot-served mirror

limits.value: 10 TB of transfer on Starter with inbound unmetered at 1 Gbit; the vendor prints the allowance without a period and the tracker states it per month, so the wall is the byte count rather than the port
